name: B4X
recommendation: Exact-file official Linguist language override for the existing genuine B4J non-UI module; no source changes or verification counter changes.

diagnosis.reason: B4X rule expects an IDE-exported B4J=true (or B4A/B4R/B4i) metadata key in the first ten lines; current Main.bas is the genuine module text meant to be inserted in the B4J IDE, not an exported module with metadata.

sources.supports: Existing corpus provenance for B4J module; primary guide linked by corpus README, browse tool could not retrieve in this turn.

limitations: Git check-attr proves exact path selection, not the eventual GitHub background cache refresh. GitHub API must be queried after the parent applies, commits and pushes.
This override fixes classification only; syntax_verified and semantic_verified remain false until real B4J validation.
Do not insert an un-commented B4J=true metadata line directly into the module source just to satisfy a detector. Use a real IDE export if choosing the metadata alternative.
scope: Classification only; source, native verification flags and extension records unchanged.
